ios.desc:
Moving to the Netherlands or just visiting? Make your Dutch journey smooth, stress-free, and exciting with the ultimate all-in-one guide.

Whether you just landed at Schiphol or you've been here for years, NLExpats gives you everything you need to navigate life in the Netherlands -- from finding the best restaurants to understanding Dutch culture.

EXPLORE CITIES
Dive into detailed guides for Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht, The Hague, and 20+ Dutch cities. Each guide includes places to visit, local tips, and maps.

STAY UPDATED
Never miss an event. Browse upcoming festivals, markets, and cultural events with one-tap calendar integration.

DAILY LIFE MADE EASY
Find restaurants, coffee shops, supermarkets, healthcare providers, and essential services -- all curated for expats.

PRACTICAL GUIDES
From public transport to driving, banking to insurance, dating to real estate -- we cover the topics that actually matter when you're building a life abroad.

SAVE WHAT MATTERS
Bookmark your favorite places, restaurants, and events. Access them anytime, even offline.

FEATURES
20+ city guides with photos and maps
Upcoming events with Add to Calendar
Restaurant, coffee shop, and market listings
Health, insurance, and banking guides
Bookmark and share content
Dark mode support
Push notifications for new events

Completely FREE, NO ADS

BUILT BY EXPATS, FOR EXPATS

NLExpats is made by people who've been through the same journey. We know what it's like to figure out the OV-chipkaart, find a GP, or decode a Dutch birthday circle.
Download NLExpats and start feeling at home in the Netherlands.
